online co op for twilight princess. 2 to 16 players in one world.

put crests_of_courage.dusk in dusklight's mods folder. a co op tab shows up in the menu bar.
one player presses host and reads out the room, everyone else types it and presses join.

for dusklight 2.0.3. everyone has to update: it only connects to 1.8.3.

this build:
- reworked story sync, should fix the missing npc softlocks
- story updates your room without a load screen
- fixed small keys getting eaten
- fixed poes coming back or vanishing before you can take the soul
- time only syncs with players in your room
- beamos, dragged objects, midna jumps and rocks sync
- epona shows up for everyone after rescue
- fixed swords copying colors
- fixed sky book extras in rando
- fixed a rival crash
- fixed not loading with non english usernames
- players on the same wifi can use room codes now
